snippet.title: Tingus Goose - Launch Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Get it on: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3629780/Tingus_Goose/

Tingus Goose is a delightfully absurd idle game where you plant seeds in patients, bounce babies for profit, and ascend through surreal worlds toward riches.

It's time to sow the seeds of fortune! Plant your seeds in patients' conveniently empty torsos, add water, and watch a towering goose-tree burst with fresh Babies — nature's most renewable source of cash.

🧠 Master the Goose-Powered Machine
OPTIMIZE: The secret to massive profit lies in strategically placing your Blossoms for optimal Baby bouncing.

SYNERGIES: Slot Specimens to build runaway synergies that supercharge every Baby bounce and boost your yield.

PROGRESS: Treat new Patients and unlock Surreal Worlds, each with its own unique twists and challenges.

Mastermind this goose-powered Rube Goldberg machine, born from the twisted mind of animator MasterTingus.

Each run offers a uniquely bizarre and unforgettable experience. Can you grow your goose tall enough to kiss its lover? Love (and profit) finds a way!

Collect and unlock over 150 bits of 𓅬 content! Embark on 17 deeply unsettling chapters filled with weird romance and awkward stories.

#TingusGoose #IdleGame #ClickerGame #IdleSim #SimulationGame #SurrealGame #IndieGame #MasterTingus #NewGame #GooseGame #Gamer #PCGaming
